choices.content: A sequence cannot contain repeated numbers
A sequence must have infinitely many terms
Order matters in a sequence, while order does not matter in a set of numbers
Every term of a sequence must be positive

question.prompt: Which of the following best explains the difference between a sequence and a set of numbers?

solutions.explanation: A sequence is arranged in order. Rearranging the same numbers generally gives a different sequence.
solutions.title: Use the ordered nature of a sequence
